verdict.rationale: The docs contain static code snippets (Python, TypeScript, Rust) and an llms.txt index. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or examples that can be run in the browser, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. Static snippets are adjacent material, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
